'''Servant Twenty-two''' was a [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] and [[Servant]] of the former [[Sith Emperor/Legends|Sith Emperor]] [[Tenebrae]]. Servant Twenty-two participated in the [[Mission to Kira Carsen's ship|assault on Kira Carsen's ship]] and was attempting to fix ship systems sabotaged by [[T7-O1]] with [[Servant Fifteen]], but was struck down by [[Alliance Commander|the Alliance Commander]] and his team.<ref name="Echoes of Oblivion" />
